_comment: CLEANED lexicon. Structure: {canonical: [variant, ...]}. TWO sections, split by MECHANISM not semantics: `lexicon` (single words, exact-match lookup) and `phrases` (multi-word, regex replacement). There are deliberately NO acronym/proper_noun/word categories: nothing in the data can tell you that `afzal` is a name but `aasman` (sky) is a word — source casing is arbitrary and an English dictionary fails both ways. A confidently-wrong category is worse than none. Canonicals keep their correct case (CNIC, Chughtai); variants are ALWAYS lowercase (lookup lowercases its input). Keys are unique case-insensitively — enforced by _assert_invariants(). The ASR context glossary comes from the curated data/entities.json instead.
